blocks.text: Origin / creation. Shelter communities organized routing practices, decoys, encryption, selective silence, and ordinary-looking traffic into a coordinated concealment institution.
Identity / human status. Artificial collective authority. Its members and exact composition changed repeatedly.
Importance. The Assembly protected the Shelter from detection and made privacy a civilizational capability rather than an individual trick.

Decline or transformation. Secrecy concentrated unreviewed power, and the Shadow Breach exposed the danger of privileged routes. The Assembly was reorganized several times and divided into security, privacy, and Bridge bodies.

Final status / surviving function. Dissolved as one authority. Veil methods survive in world boundaries, Gate protections, and the principle that safety may require concealment without making secrecy morally neutral.
